title: Maximum Number of Words You Can Type
summary: Determine the count of words in a text that can be fully typed on a keyboard with certain broken letter keys.
statement: Determine the count of words in a text that can be fully typed on a keyboard with certain broken letter keys.
constraints: text contains 1 through 1000 lowercase letters and single spaces between words.
broken_letters contains distinct lowercase letters and may be empty.
A word is typable only when none of its letters is broken.
hints: A word fails as soon as any of its characters belongs to the broken-letter set.
Build a set once, then test each whitespace-separated word for an empty intersection.
Split the sentence; count words for which no character is in broken.
The predicate examines every character of each word, so it accepts exactly the words constructible with working keys.
editorial: The predicate examines every character of each word, so it accepts exactly the words constructible with working keys.
